reason: The repair cell needs both the copied instructions and amino acids to build collagen, so the cell is the natural place to use them.
expectation: The cell will use the instructions and available amino acids to make collagen.

effect: The cell used the instructions and amino acids to make collagen chains, which now need processing and export.
reaction: The intact RNA template and growing chain make the protein-building step clear.
reason: The processing and export membranes are the visible next step for getting the new chains outside the cell.
expectation: The membranes will process the collagen and help deliver it outside the repair cell.

effect: The collagen has been exported and assembled into supporting fibers, which can now replace material beneath the scrape.
reaction: The sequence from protein production to fibers outside the cell is satisfying and clear.
reason: The new fibers appear to be the support needed in the damaged tissue.
expectation: The fibers will fill in supporting material beneath the damaged skin.

effect: The new fibers filled the deeper gap, while the surface cells still need to close over it.
reaction: The remaining surface gap makes the next repair goal clear.
reason: Local repair signals appear to act on the skin cells at the scrape’s edge, preparing them to close the gap.

choice.with: Skin cells at the scrape’s edge

expectation: The signals will prompt the edge cells to renew or move across the gap.

effect: The repair signals prompted surface cells to divide and spread toward the gap; they can now be applied to the rebuilding body.
reaction: The sequence makes the cells’ response to local signals clear.
reason: The spreading cells should close the remaining surface gap.
expectation: The surface cells will cover the gap and restore protective layers.

effect: The surface barrier is closed, while the deeper collagen continues to remodel and strengthen.
reaction: The distinction between a closed surface and ongoing deeper repair is a useful ending.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making collagen inside the repair cell and following it through export was most worthwhile. The picture descriptions connect instructions and raw materials to support outside the cell.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the finished fibers to the body was clear but predictable; the preceding result had already shown them assembling outside the cell.

surprise.text: I was struck that the surface could close while deeper collagen still needed remodeling. Closure is not the end of repair.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless. The cell, materials and wound-edge signals had clear roles, though the game treated complex processes as single combinations.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter if it offered another concrete process to build. This chapter made the relationship between cell work and tissue repair clear, although its combinations were mostly predictable.
